claims.claim: S100A9 expression showed excellent performance for diagnosing active UC
claims.quote: The receiver operating characteristic curve demonstrates the excellent performance of S100A9 expression in diagnosing active UC.

claims.claim: S100A9 was upregulated in UC
claims.reason: Cited papers give hub gene, mouse overexpression or on-treatment changes, not a UC-vs-control increase.

claims.claim: IRF5 represses S100A9 and limits G-MDSC accumulation

claims.claim: In treatment responders S100A9 was downregulated in resident macrophages

claims.claim: LCN2 was upregulated in UC
claims.quote: CCL20, CCL21, CD55, IDO1, LCN2, NOS2, CCL11, OLFM4, ANXA1, REG1A, S100A9, SLPI, SPINK1, and AGR2 were significantly higher
claims.reason: LCN2 significantly higher in UC patients vs controls.

claims.claim: LCN2 was upregulated in IBD
claims.reason: Cited papers concern UC and UC-associated cancer, not IBD generally.

claims.claim: LCN2 expression was higher in short-duration UC than long-duration UC, higher in long-duration UC than UC-associated cancer, and higher in all of them than normal
claims.quote: The expression level of LCN2 in short-duration UC was higher than that of long-duration UC (P < 0.01), long-duration UC was higher than that of UCAC (P = 0.001), and UC and UCAC were all higher than that of the normal (P < 0.001).

claims.claim: HMGCS2 is consistently reported as decreased in UC in two studies

claims.claim: HMGCS2 has high diagnostic value in two studies
claims.quote: These genes had high sensitivity and specificity in receiver operating characteristic curve analysis.
claims.reason: Second study reports high sensitivity and specificity; first reports high diagnostic value.
